QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` and "The default protects the library's API boundary, meaning application developers who include the public headers. The opt-out is for code that is part of the library or the test tooling." Also: "An application that defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` before including mbedtls headers gets direct access"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain member names, while ordinary consumers of the public headers see the renamed `private_` names.
